headline: Raya Cyber Solutions Debuts at Cairo ICT with Over 45 Security Services
summary: Raya Cyber Solutions, a subsidiary of Raya Information Technology, is showcasing a portfolio of over 45 cybersecurity services at Cairo ICT 2026 to expand its market presence.
why: Growth in cybersecurity service portfolios addresses rising enterprise demand for data protection and artificial intelligence infrastructure security in emerging digital economies.

impacts.name: Cybersecurity Sector
impacts.why: Expansion of commercial service offerings captures growing enterprise security demand.
